claims.summary: Fallen Empires 1994-11-01, credited artist Bryon Wackwitz.

Order of Leitbur does not have first strike automatically. Paying {W} grants it first strike until end of turn; paying {W}{W} makes it 3/1 until end of turn. Protection from black is separate from the first-strike ability and does not protect against colorless artifact damage. A previously controlled Order blocks an attacking Juggernaut (5/3). Before first-strike damage, tap three Plains for {W} to grant first strike and {W}{W} to raise power from two to three. The Order deals lethal three damage first; Juggernaut is destroyed before the normal combat damage step and never hits back.
